semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Schmidt Scientific Taiwan Ltd. distributes equipment and provides technical services relevant to the semiconductor industry, particularly in testing and inspection.
summary: Schmidt Scientific Taiwan Ltd. specializes in the distribution of production systems, testing systems, and metrology and inspection equipment for the semiconductor industry. They focus on providing comprehensive after-sales service and have established a strong presence in Taiwan and China.
capabilities: Production systems for electronic and energy sectors

regional_presence.Taiwan: SST has established branch offices in Hsinchu, Taichung, and Kaohsiung to support local customers.
regional_presence.China: SST has expanded into the Chinese market with offices in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing.
